hero.title: Cooling and heating for any facility — engineered to spec
hero.lead: VRF, VRV, chillers, ventilation and split systems: design, supply, installation and turnkey service.

services.sub: A full cycle of work handled by one team — from consultation and equipment selection to commissioning and service.

consult.title: Free consultation
consult.desc: Our engineers calculate the load free of charge and propose a solution for your facility.

equipment.title: Equipment selection
equipment.desc: Official brands: Shivaki, AUX, Toshiba, Hisense, Mitsubishi Electric.

install.title: Installation and service
install.desc: Installation and repair of heating, ventilation and cooling systems of any complexity.

team.title: A team with 20+ years of experience
team.desc: In-house installation crews and HVAC design engineers.

projects.sub: Open a project to see photos of the systems installed on site.

caex.title: Central Asian Expo (CAEx)
caex.card: Heating, ventilation and air conditioning systems ensuring comfort at every event of the exhibition centre.
caex.desc: Supply and exhaust ventilation and air conditioning for the exhibition halls: large-section ducts, cassette indoor units and rooftop outdoor units.

opera.title: Tashkent City Opera
opera.card: An advanced VRF system creates ideal climate conditions for audiences and performers.
opera.desc: Installation of a VRF system and ventilation for the auditorium and foyer: outdoor units on the technical roof, concealed routing of pipework and ducts.

ramada.title: ZAMIN HOTELS RAMADA
ramada.card: VRF systems and a boiler house: high energy efficiency and precise climate control for guests.
ramada.desc: VRF systems in guest rooms and public areas, a Ferroli gas boiler house with pipework and pump groups.

school.title: Presidential School in Tashkent
school.card: Shivaki cassette VRF systems and supply ventilation in the academic buildings.
school.desc: Shivaki cassette VRF systems in classrooms, supply ventilation with heat recovery, duct routing across the floors.

yurt.title: Yurt in Karakalpakstan
yurt.card: Shivaki VRF systems at a facility listed in the Guinness Book of Records.
yurt.desc: Shivaki VRF systems for the domed hall: outdoor units on an outrigger frame, air supply around the perimeter of the structure.

renaissance.title: Renaissance University
renaissance.card: Energy-efficient climate in the university's academic and administrative buildings.
renaissance.desc: AUX VRF systems in the academic and administrative buildings, installation of outdoor units on the facade roof and a boiler house for heating.

about.h2: PROHVAC — heating, ventilation and air conditioning
about.p1: ProHVAC is a specialist in the installation and maintenance of VRF, VRV, chiller systems, ventilation and split air conditioners. We offer tailored climate control solutions for residential, commercial and industrial facilities, ensuring comfort, energy efficiency and durability.
about.p2: Using equipment from leading manufacturers, our specialists deliver high-quality installation and maintenance: precise temperature control, improved air quality and reduced energy consumption.
